_comment: Unity 6 (6000.4.11f1). UGUI 2.0 already includes TextMeshPro. com.unity.cloud.gltfast loads the .glb props in StreamingAssets/Models at runtime (GKMC_GLTFAST define in Assets/csc.rsp); com.unity.postprocessing provides bloom/ACES/vignette for the Built-in pipeline (GKMC_POSTFX define). UPM pulls transitive dependencies (mathematics/burst/collections) automatically. Removing either package + its define line reverts that feature; the code falls back automatically.
